versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-opportunity-discovery: an AI business consultant skill for assessing where AI can (and cannot) help a business.
- Follows a structured, interview-based process before recommending any AI or automation solution.
- Delivers a written opportunity assessment, including prioritized use cases, feasibility and impact scoring, risks, build-vs-buy guidance, and a phased roadmap.
- Explicitly flags when traditional automation or off-the-shelf software is a better fit than AI.
- Designed for business owners and decision-makers seeking practical, evidence-based AI opportunity discovery.
